---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new feature or improvement
title: "[feature] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
---

## Problem

What's currently friction-y or missing? Describe the situation you're in when you
feel the gap. Concrete is better than abstract.

## Proposed solution

A rough sketch of what you have in mind. It doesn't need to be a full spec — a
description of the desired behavior is enough to start a conversation.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about, and why you ruled them out (or didn't).

## Additional context

Screenshots, related issues, links to prior art, or anything else that helps frame
the request.
